verdict.rationale: Context-Aware Access explicitly lets admins build granular access policies based on device security status (managed, encrypted, screen-locked via Endpoint Verification) before granting app access, and device password/encryption requirements are documented in endpoint management docs. Community evidence corroborates real-world enforcement (e.g., Firefox users blocked due to lacking the Endpoint Verification plugin) but also documents significant friction — opaque policy failures with no way to see which rule blocked access, and full enforcement effectively requiring Managed Chrome. Missing for 10: clearer diagnostics/visibility into which posture check failed, and broader browser-agnostic enforcement without Chrome dependency.
